## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d43e9a99ed85c9daa44c871ca75e91b2368279af`
Local-runs: none

Read-only review of the one-file diff `origin/main...refs/review/pr-23035` (merge-base `3071d3e989`; `origin/main` at `edecd44851` at the final read; the ADR is unchanged on `main` since the merge-base), the PR body, labels and its empty comment and review lists, the head's check-runs, the card's ruling `6121741984` (letter A and "The record" paragraph), the decision analysis `6119820661`, the dev report `6123413708`, the seat answer `6123453723`, card #22788's E0 row, PR #22707's reviews and merge data, and on `origin/main` the full ADR-0139 and `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` around `executeWithMiddleware`, `find`, `findOne`, `count` and `aggregate`. `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` was read from `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` on `origin/main`.

### ① Derived judgments

**The diff.** One file, `docs/adr/0139-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf-readable-parent-ids.md`, +14 / -7, two hunks: the status paragraph (branch lines 3 to 13) and D2's position sentence (branch lines 133 to 136). The whitespace-insensitive diffstat is the same +14 / -7, `git diff --check` is clean, the final newline is kept, and the file goes from 285 to 292 lines. Nothing outside the two hunks moves.

**D2's amended sentence says what the ruling orders.** The ruling's letter A: "compose once on the final AST, at the executor boundary", composing "immediately before each driver call, after the middleware chain and the before-hooks" on `find`, `findOne`, `count` and `aggregate`; its "The record" paragraph: "the one position sentence at `:127-129`, naming the executor boundary after the before-hooks and immediately before each driver call". The branch's sentence (lines 133 to 136) reads: "At the engine's executor boundary — on the final AST, after ingress parsing, the comparand doors, the middleware chain (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#executeWithMiddleware`) and the before-hooks, immediately before each driver call of `find`, `findOne`, `count` and `aggregate` — every `ReadableIds` leaf is replaced by its composed form, still branded, before any driver sees it:". Every element the ruling names is present, the four verbs by name; "ingress parsing, the comparand doors" is carried over from the old sentence and is still true (both run in `resolveWhereTokens`, before the chain).

**It names the real seam.** Read on `origin/main` `edecd44851`: `executeWithMiddleware` (`engine.ts:5870`) runs the object's applicable middlewares and then the executor innermost. `find`: `resolveWhereTokens` at `:13160` (which runs `lowerRelationConditions` through `resolveRelateThenLowerWhere`, `:12750`), then `executeWithMiddleware` `:13162`, `beforeFind` `:13174`, `driver.find` `:13178`. `findOne`: `:13450`, `:13452`, `beforeFind` `:13468`, `driver.findOne` `:13471`. `count`: `:18971`, `:18983`, `driver.count` `:18986` (no before-hook runs; the fallback for a driver without `count` re-enters `this.find`, so it meets `find`'s own boundary). `aggregate`: `:19396` and `:19430`, then `:19438`, then `drv.aggregate` `:19495` or `driver.find` `:19539`, two exclusive driver paths, both inside the executor, no before-hook. So the old seam, `lowerRelationConditions`, precedes the chain on every read verb, and the new sentence names the last engine position before each driver call. On `count` and `aggregate` "after the before-hooks" is vacuous, exactly as in the ruling's own wording; not a misstatement. These positions equal the dev's readings on `9432bac077`.

**The rest of D2 is unchanged.** Steps 1 to 3 (lines 138 to 147), the composed form `{ object: P, scope }` (line 146) and the uncomposed refusal at the driver (lines 149 to 152) are byte-identical to `main`; the second hunk replaces only `main`'s lines 127 to 129.

**No contradiction with D1, D4 or D5.** D1 (lines 128 to 129) keeps the leaf legal on the same four verbs and refused on a write verb, in a `having`, or off a `$in` comparand; the new D2 names the same four verbs and moves no refusal. D4 (line 183) still has the consumers' branches "ANDed into the read's `where` as today", inside the middleware chain; with composition now after the chain, the D2/D4 contradiction the ruling names is gone. D5 (lines 201 to 220) names no position; its three refusal classes stand. `lowerRelationConditions` appears exactly once in the whole record, at line 6, as the seam replaced; E2's plan row (line 287) says "the engine seam composes the leaf", position-neutral. No sentence still places composition at `lowerRelationConditions`.

**The status line is true.** PR #22707 carries one review: os-zhuang, APPROVED, on 2026-10-11 at 06:02 UTC, on its head `f87ef2345a`; it was merged by os-zhuang on 2026-10-11 at 06:38 UTC as `a2e94c2a05`; os-zhuang is in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`. "Accepted (2026-10-11), accepted by the merge that landed it on `main` (#22707)" is the E0 row's wording on #22788, with #22707 as a link; "proposed 2026-10-10" keeps the original date. The PR body's two times for #22707 match the review and merge data.

**The Amended note is accurate and its link is right.** "Amended (2026-10-12)": the ruling comment `6121741984` was posted on 2026-10-12 on issue #22861, letter A; the note's link `issues/22861#issuecomment-6121741984` resolves to it. The note's description of the change, the executor boundary after the middleware chain and the before-hooks, immediately before each driver call, in place of the seam where `lowerRelationConditions` runs, "which precedes the chain D4's emitters write into", matches the engine reading above and the ruling's own reading.

**The two tense changes are faithful.** "becomes Accepted" to "became Accepted", and "stays in the ruling's letter D state" to "stayed": both sit in the paragraph the E0 row covers, both describe the pre-acceptance period as past, neither moves a decision. One residual reading: "Until then the platform stayed in the letter D state" can be read as the platform having left letter D at acceptance, which it has not (E2 onward are unlanded); that reading is inherited from the original "Until then", the next clause keeps letter C as the present interim, and the ruling's "E0's status line may ride in it" covers the paragraph. Not a defect of this diff.

**Nothing else moves.** Two hunks only; the head is one commit over the merge-base; `mergeable_state` is clean at the final read.

### ② Semver level

Docs only, under `docs/adr/**`; no package publishes. `Clause-②: no` is right and `skip-changeset` is the right disposition: no changeset is owed. At the final read the label is on the PR, and the newest `Check Changeset` run on the head is `skipped` (an earlier run, before the label, failed and is superseded).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Tier H, stated.** The PR body says: Tier H, draft only, lands only on an APPROVED review by an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, and no seat readies it, queues it or arms auto-merge on it. At the final read: draft, `auto_merge` null, no reviews, no comments, no requested reviewers; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is success. This record does not lift the landing; the maintainer's APPROVED review does.
- **Dev deviations that concern this PR.** (a) The tense change: declared in the dev report and in the PR body; judged faithful above. (b) `skip-changeset` left to the seat because the dispatch forbids label writes: present on the PR at the final read. (c) The code PR was not built (the case-set stop); by the ruling "E2's code PR does not wait for the text", and the seat answer puts the record PR on its own track, so it has no bearing on this verdict. (d) The commit carries the model-free trailer pair; the PR body carries the session-URL footer and `Part of #22861` with no closing keyword, and the "Part-of PR must not also close its card" check is success.
- **Check-runs on the head.** 43, all completed; none pending. Of the seven required contexts: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are success; `Build Core` and `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` are skipped on a docs-only diff.
- **Not in scope of this PR**, carried by the seat answer: D2 step 2's lowering parenthetical, the deny sentinel's spread copies (#23009), and the write refusal's position. The ruling amends only the position sentence, and the record text is otherwise untouched, which is the right scope.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-22861-adr-0139-d2-executor-boundary`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADzJtzYTLUfgrRZHxkagkX`

**VERDICT: PASS**


Adopted by `domain:engine#2` (`session_01ADzJtzYTLUfgrRZHxkagkX`) at 2026-10-12T11:46Z. The record came from an isolated at-tier reviewer. Its transcript shows read-only tool use: REST reads, a fetch into a review ref and repository reads, and its only writes were its own scratch files. This record does not lift the landing. The PR is Tier H, stays a draft, and lands only on an APPROVED review by an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`.

## 维护者速读

**改了什么:** ADR-0139 里两处文字,只改文档,不动代码:
1. D2 的「组合点」位置那一句,改成「在执行器边界:最终查询上,中间件链和前置钩子之后,每次真正查库之前」。这是你在 #22861 裁定的 A。
2. 状态行从「Proposed」改成「Accepted (2026-10-11),由 #22707 合入」,即 #22788 上一直欠着的 E0,顺带补一条 Amended (2026-10-12) 记录这次改动。

**为什么改:** 原文把组合点放在中间件链之前,可它自己点名的六个使用方(活动流、审计、评论等)都在中间件链里才写入叶子,原文自相矛盾。你已裁 A,代码按新位置实现,这份 ADR 要跟上,否则以后读 ADR 的 agent 会照旧位置写错。

**风险与代价(含回滚):** 纯文字,不影响运行时。契约复核 PASS:新句逐项对上裁决,其余段落一字未动,全文不再有把组合点放在旧位置的句子。回滚就是 revert 这一个文档提交。

**席位意见:** 建议批准。它只把你已裁的结论和早已成立的接受状态写进记录,没有新增任何决定。

**你要做的:** 在 PR #23035 上点 Approve。批准后席位负责落地。
